english.note: This is the all-purpose word for a personal journal or diary of daily experiences.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese choice for a personal diary or daily record.

examples.english: I write in my diary every day, recording what happened that day.
examples.traditional: 我每日都寫日記，記低嗰日發生嘅事。
